items.promptText: What is Role 1’s total annual compensation, counting wages and benefits?
What is Role 2’s total annual compensation?
What is Role 3’s total annual compensation?
How many months does Role 2’s gain over Role 1 take to repay its $3,900 program cost? Round to the nearest month.
How many months does Role 3’s gain over Role 1 take to repay its $18,400 program cost? Round to the nearest month.
Counting the 24 months of Role 3’s program before any of that pay begins, how long from starting the program until the $18,400 is repaid?
Recommend one of the three fictional roles for someone who needs steady income within six months, and defend it against the role with the highest total compensation.
State one figure in your three income profiles that you are least confident in, and say what would change your recommendation if it were wrong.
